newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt paper, interbank rates up on thin trade.
newsitem.headline: HK govt paper, interbank rates up on thin trade.

text.p: Hong Kong government paper yields and interbank rates were up on Tuesday in thin trade, dealers said.
Yields of one-week bills rose to 4.48 percent from 4.43 at Monday midday.
Three-year notes yielded 6.19 percent versus 6.12, five-year notes yielded 6.66 percent against 6.58, and seven-year notes yielded 6.87 percent against 6.78.
Interbank rates also climbed due to next week's Chinese New Year holidays as players covered their positions before the holiday, a dealer with a Japanese bank said.
Thursday through Saturday next week are public holidays.
The overnight rate rose a hair to 5-1/2 7/16 percent from 5-1/2 3/8 at Monday's midday. Three-month money rate was at 5-9/16 1/2 percent versus 5-3/8 5/16.
